name: Destroyer sound circuits
drawing: Sound section of the Destroyer game board schematic, sheet 4 of 5, technical manual TM-106 (doc 50fd79545404, p. 37) -- via MAME's netlist, compared with it
revision: Destroyer game board, sound section: noise (two 74LS164s), explosion, sonar, launch and motor sounds, mixed into the volume pot.
coverage: Converted from MAME's netlist and compared with sheet 4, up to the volume pot's wiper; the TDA1004 amplifier after it is not in MAME. The spare gates MAME ties off are other circuits' on the board, and are ports here.
